review: Inspected source and changed tests first. Rolling dispatch checks durable eligibility before entering run, therefore before expensive createPrivateBokEscrow/PXE interface registration. Unchanged running journal with unknown billing or no retained acceptance is skipped; terminal phases are skipped; reply intents remain eligible for exact reconciliation.

Durable hints are read under lease using existing restricted file reader; binding identity must match. Local accepted/prepared metadata is re-read each visit and after restart without publication, generated execution, billing mutation or cached authorization.

False eligibility removes only current queued row, leaves same-process failure and lastSuccess untouched, and allows unrelated threads to progress. Current canonical predecessor check still gates each eligible dispatch; shutdown cannot launch a new job after admission.

Prepared metadata is intentionally optimistic eligibility only. Full normal recovery continues validating exact Git refs, canonical billing, retained artifacts, mirror publication, and uncertain reply transactions; no provider replay or weakened success checks.

Tests retain exact accepted/terminal/uncertain reply fences and cover source state changes, same-thread ordering, unrelated progress, shutdown, restart and no success on skip. No tracked edits or live services used.
limitations: Fresh-process health state is still memory-only and may report ready while durable fenced requests exist; ready is not evidence all requests completed. Lead explicitly retained this existing limitation within current bounded scope, not a waiver of broader operator visibility requirements.
Prepared metadata can admit an ultimately invalid exact-ref candidate to full recovery; hint is not authorization or successful acceptance.
No Docker/chain/provider calls or full application journey. Normal integration gate remains lead responsibility.
